1.4.18.en: Fixed 'wrong password' errors on newer HTTPS Deco firmware (e.g. X50-5G v2, P9). The app now auto-detects and remembers the correct login protocol per device. Also fixed noisy base64 log errors for plain-text device nicknames and redacted passwords from diagnostic logs.

1.4.19.en: Fixed 'wrong password' errors on newer HTTPS Deco firmware (e.g. X50-5G v2, P9). The app now auto-detects and remembers the correct login protocol per device. Also fixed noisy base64 log errors for plain-text device nicknames and redacted passwords from diagnostic logs.

1.4.20.en: Added three new flow cards: 'Any client changed status' (fires for any device without pre-selecting a specific client), 'A new client connected for the first time' (fires once per device ever seen), and 'A client changed Deco node' (fires when a specific client roams between Deco nodes, showing old and new node names).

1.4.21.en: Added two dashboard widgets: 'Client Presence' (shows online/offline status, Deco node, and last-seen time for any tracked device) and 'Network Throughput' (shows live download/upload speeds and connected client count across the mesh).

1.4.34.en: Fix Client Presence widget showing a spinning icon when no MAC address is configured

1.4.35.en: Fixed login failure on X50 and X55 routers running firmware 1.8.0 or newer. These models require a different request format during authentication — the app was sending the wrong format, which caused the router to reject the login with a misleading "Wrong password" error even when the password was correct. Reduced unnecessary background API calls on non-LTE models and X50-5G routers.

1.4.36.en: Fixed login on routers that reject the JSON body format immediately after a firmware Lua crash (added a short recovery delay before retrying). Added LTE/5G capability support for X50-5G and other 5G NR models that use the 'nr_intf_cfg' endpoint. Added a login diagnostic view: when a Deco model uses an unknown login protocol, pairing now shows which formats were tried and lets the user copy a ready-to-paste GitHub issue report including model and firmware version.

1.4.37.en: Added mesh-wide client presence: new "client joined/left the Deco Mesh" triggers and a  "client is present in the Deco Mesh" condition. These track a client across all Deco nodes at once, so roaming between nodes no longer causes false online/offline flips in flows. Fixed a misleading "unrecognised login protocol" error that could appear when re-pairing right after deleting devices — this was actually the router's previous session not yet being released, so pairing now retries automatically before showing that screen.

1.4.42.en: Fixed pairing getting stuck on "Loading" after a successful login. Extended the retry window for routers that take longer to release a previous session, so pairing and repair succeed more often without manual retries. Fixed crash and error reports not reaching our monitoring, so issues can now be diagnosed and fixed faster.

1.4.43.en: Fixed pairing/repair failing with a "previous session is still active" error when other Deco nodes from the same mesh were already added — pairing now shares the same login session as your existing devices instead of competing with them for the router's single session slot.

1.4.44.en: Fixed mesh-wide client presence ("client joined/left the Deco Mesh") failing to detect any clients on most models — it now builds the mesh-wide view from data already being collected, instead of a request the router was rejecting.
